mapper.select: SELECT id, task_id, sort_order, section_title, section_level, char_count, score, dimensions, strengths, weaknesses, risks, suggestions, raw_response, status, error_msg, create_time FROM ai_review_section WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY sort_order

SELECT id, task_id, sort_order, section_title, section_level, char_count, score, dimensions, strengths, weaknesses, risks, suggestions, raw_response, status, error_msg, create_time FROM ai_review_section WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_review_section (task_id, sort_order, section_title, section_level, char_count, score, dimensions, strengths, weaknesses, risks, suggestions, raw_response, status, error_msg, create_time) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{sortOrder}, #{sectionTitle}, #{sectionLevel}, #{charCount}, #{score}, #{dimensions}, #{strengths}, #{weaknesses}, #{risks}, #{suggestions}, #{rawResponse}, #{status}, #{errorMsg}, #{createTime})
